title: Alaska News Nightly: Monday, September 21, 2026
text:
Monday on Alaska News Nightly

An Anchorage police shooting brings attention to problem properties, and a reporter takes a deep dive on President Trump's appointee to the U.S. Arctic Research Commission.

Also, sure, it's election season — but it's also about time to vote on your favorite salmon-stuffed bear.

Reports tonight from:

Tim Ellis in Delta JunctionWesley Early and Ava White in AnchorageAshlyn O'Hara in SoldotnaLauren Salemo in Sitkaand Hunter Morrison in Ketchikan

This episode of Alaska News Nightly is hosted by Casey Grove with audio engineering from Toben Shelby and production by Patrick Gilchrist.
